verdict.rationale: Skyfire documents its own settlement path: sellers charge pay/kya-pay tokens and Skyfire moves funds between buyer and seller wallets, with explicit timing windows. Nothing in the evidence says this settlement uses stablecoins. The wallets are described as pre-funded or 'Credits' wallets and the other documented rail is card networks, so the stablecoin element at the core of the story is unevidenced and wallet settlement is only an adjacent capability.
